notes: All imports, component props, parts, hotkey/gesture actions, CSS custom properties, and data attributes used in the final code map cleanly onto the installed @videojs/react@10.0.0-beta.23 type surface. Top-level exports (BufferingIndicator, CaptionsButton, Container, Controls, FullscreenButton, Gesture, Hotkey, MuteButton, PiPButton, PlayButton, PlaybackRateButton, Poster, Time, TimeSlider, createPlayer) are present in dist/dev/index.d.ts; the subpath imports `@videojs/react/video` (videoFeatures) and `@videojs/react/media/hls-video` (HlsVideo) match the package.json `exports` map. The compound parts used (Time.Value with type=current|duration, TimeSlider.Root/Track/Buffer/Fill/Thumb, Controls.Root) and prop names (Hotkey keys/action/value, Gesture type/action/pointer/region, BufferingIndicator render, Poster src/alt) are all declared in the corresponding .d.ts files.
